title: Space Exploration History
text: The Space Age began on October 4, 1957, when the Soviet Union launched Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite. Yuri Gagarin became the first human in space on April 12, 1961. NASA's Apollo program, motivated by Cold War competition, achieved the first crewed Moon landing on July 20, 1969. The Hubble Space Telescope, launched in 1990, transformed astronomy by providing images of unprecedented clarity. The International Space Station (ISS), a joint project of 15 nations, has been continuously inhabited since November 2000. Private space companies SpaceX, Blue Origin, and Virgin Galactic have developed reusable rockets, dramatically reducing launch costs. The Artemis program aims to return humans to the Moon.
